title: Run the verify-repair Agentic Recipe until verification succeeds
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He loads Agentic Recipe `verify_repair` with a fixture artifact that fails the first verify, runs `run_recipe`, and verifies one repair attempt makes verification succeed under the stop contract. Complements `fangore_bounded_repair_loop` for loop helper semantics. [^insp-pa-03-verify]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `verify_repair` via `VerifyRepairTemplate` / `verify_repair_runner` and product verb `run_recipe` (`VerifyRepairRecipeAdapter`).
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `verify_repair_recipe.yaml` drives `run_recipe`; expects verification_passed, repair_attempts, final_status plus shape keys.
